description.text: Welcome to VH Tweaks 3rd Edition!

This modpack turns your Minecraft experience into a progression based Action RPG. Each time you play can be a completely different experience. 

Before you start playing, make sure to set your vault difficulty; easy, normal, hard, impossible, fragged. 

Vault Hunters features three game modes; Normal, Casual and Hardcore with Normal being the default gamemode. Type /gamerule vaultMode [mode] to change gamemodes. 

The difference in gamemodes is what you lose when you die. After Lv20 in casual you will not lose items. In Normal you will have to buy back your items. In Hardcore you lose items permanently. 

Consider grouping up with friends; use /party invite [playername]. 

Invite friends to work on research together with /the_vault research_team invite [playername].

WoldsVaults adds new vault gear, vault objectives, vault crafting ingredients, loot boxes, and much more.
Some additions include:

Vault Trident: a melee weapon that does more damage when thrown.
Vault Magestaff: a one handed Ability weapon.
Vaultarang: a ranged throwing weapon.
Vault Sack: an offhand item that provides looting buffs.
Vault Plushie: an offhand item that provides combat buffs.

Vault Hunters has an in-depth Ability and Talent system. 

Abilities typically focus on giving you powerful active skills that significantly change how you play the game. 

Talents provide the player with passive buffs. 

Check out the Vault UI by pressing 'H' by default and click on the second and third tabs at the top to view Abilities and Talents respectively. 

Have some skill points on us.
Watch your footing as we're playing Skyvaults this go around. The main resource gathering method will be Raw Vaults, gather a Raw Crystal from your Islands Budding Crystal.
Obtain a Raw Crystal

With Crystal in hand, right-click onto your Vault Portal to open a vault. 

Before Lv20 you will have Beginners Grace, which will prevent item loss. When you complete a vault you will be granted a Completion Crate, place it and sneak right-click to open it!
Enter A Raw Vault

At the Spawn Island is an Over Vault. Every now and then, this portal will become active.

If a portal is left open for too long the inhabitants may even venture into the Minecraft world, it's up to the group to close the portals!

Chromatic Iron is the main ore used in Vault Hunters. Raw Chromatic Iron can be found surrounded by Vault Stone in Raw Sky Vaults, in the Chromatic Caves room. 

Vault Stone when mined has a chance to drop a Vault Rock; you will need these to make Vault Crystals. You can gather Chromatic Iron ore with an Iron Pickaxe. 

Fortune does increase the yield!
Gather 16x Raw Chromatic Iron

Now that you've got some Vault Rocks, place your first Vault Rock on the Vault Altar. 

Four Ingredients will pop up, gather what is needed and drop the items on the Vault Altar. 

Once done, apply a Redstone signal to complete the Vault Crystal.
Acquire a Vault Altar
Inside Vaults you'll find different types of chests. Each chest has specific loot it holds as well as a variety of other items.
Wooden
: includes plating, carbon, and silk.
Ornate
: has gear, focuses and crafting ingredients.
Living
: contains knowledge, inscriptions, and charms.
Gilded
: holds magnets, trinkets and jewel pouches.
Item Quantity
: increases the amount of loot you find.
Item Rarity
: increases the tier of loot.
Make sure to loot every chest and start collecting everything you can.

In Vault Hunters, Enchantments are a bit different than in Vanilla Minecraft. Some Enchantments have been disabled like Protection and Offensive Enchants. 

Enchants will work on Vanilla Tools and Gear as well as Vault Tools and Gear. 

The Vault Enchanter is your go to table for enchanting any gear or tools, it will always offer the max available enchantment.
Acquire a Vault Enchanter

Vault Potions are a great way to keep yourself alive while Vaulting.

A Vault Potion will have an amount of charges, and with a little research you can make them better later on. 

There are 3 different choices;
Slaughter: Recharges with kills.
Pacifist: Recharges over time.
Goblin: Recharges while you loot.
Craft a Vial
You will have to fight your way through the Vault, mobs will drop Soul Shards. You can use these Soul Shards in the Black Market. Craft a Shard Pouch to collect them.
Acquire a Shard Pouch

As you loot chests in the Vault you'll come across coin piles. This is the main currency for Vault Hunters. These coins can be used to upgrade gear, reroll modifiers, and they have many more uses. 

Coins in a Coin Pouch will automatically be converted and used when interacting with work benches. Go ahead and make a Coin Pouch to collect these coins.
Acquire a Coin Pouch

Vault Hunters also offers bounties that you can complete while playing. We recommend crafting a Bounty Table and acquiring a Bounty. 

Bounties are a great way to earn a little extra.
Complete a Bounty

To reduce strain on servers and optimize space, Vault Hunters offers Animal Pens. 

Craft a few Animal Jars; each jar can hold a type of animal. Once you collect some Animals in Jars you can then craft and place an Animal Pen. 

Right-Click the Jars into the animal pens. Animals can still be bred in their pens, and harvested in the same way. 

You can Shift to view more info about the Animals.
Acquire an Animal Pen

The Tool Station can be used to craft tools that significantly enhance your experience in the vaults.

Check back frequently to see when you can make a new tier of tool.
Acquire a Tool Station & Craft your first Tool

Vault Tools can be modified with jewels to apply new affinities and traits to the tool. Affinity Jewels allow you to break specific chests in Vaults. Some Jewels change the functionality of the tool. Other Jewels enhance your tools looting capabilities.
Below are a list of a few modifiers for tools:
Picking
: Allows the tool to mine blocks that require a pickaxe.
Axing
: Allows the tool to mine blocks that require an axe.
Shoveling
: Allows the tool to mine blocks that require a shovel.
Reaping
: Allows the tool to mine blocks that require a hoe.
Wooden Affinity
: Allows the tool to mine Wooden Chests.
Ornate Affinity
: Allows the tool to mine Ornate Chests.
Gilded Affinity
: Allows the tool to mine Gilded Chests.
Living Affinity
: Allows the tool to mine Living Chests.
Coin Affinity
: Allows the tool to mine coin piles.
Acquire a Jewel Applicator

The Jewel Crafting Table allows you to craft a wide variety of jewels that can be applied to your tools to enhance their capabilities. 

Not all affixes are available for crafting so you will still have to find the rest while looting. Keep and eye out for Jewel Pouches!
Acquire a Jewel Crafting Table

Expertises are powerful buffs to the player. In order to reset Expertises, you will need a Neuralizer. 

As you level up you will acquire Expertise points every 5 Levels; till Level 100 for a total of 20.

After Level 100 you will have a chance to acquire Expertise Orbs from Greed.
Reach Vault Level 5

The Vault Forge is a workstation where you can craft Vault Gear. You can submit Vault Scrap to increase your proficiency.

A higher Proficieny improves:
Durability
Crafting Potential
Rarity Pool
Maximum Repair Slots
Soulbound Chance
Greater Modifier Chance
Acquire a Vault Forge

Picking up items can be a bore, instead you should obtain a Magnet. Magnets will automatically pick up items in a raidus around you.

Magnets have 2 looting modes:
Pickup: Picks up all items within range.
Void Pickup: Picks up all loot items, and voids non-loot materials.

You can toggle these modes and even turn off your magnet.
Forge a Magnet in the Vault Forge

The Artisan Station is used to modify Vault gear and weapons by spending the items Crafting Potential and paying material costs in Vault Plating and Vault Bronze.

Different Foci perform different types of reforges or upgrades. Most actions consume Crafting Potential. When it reaches zero you can go into negative Potential, but the plating and bronze costs scale exponentially.
Acquire an Artisan Station
The Vault Recycler is used to break down old and unwanted gear into Vault Scrap, Wild Focuses and Faceted Focuses. It can also be used to break down and recycle Jewels, Magnets and Inscriptions!
Acquire a Vault Recycler
The Alchemy Table is a useful table to modifying Vault Potions. You can discover new Vault Potion modifiers from discovering Alchemy Archives in Dungeons.
Acquire an Alchemy Table

As you level up, the Vault will become more challenging with Objectives.

Level 10 marks the introduction of the Light the Brazier Objective to random vaults.
Level 20 marks the introduction of the Scavenger Objective to random vaults.
Level 50 marks the introduction of the Bingo and Hunt the Runes objective to random vaults.

Blank Seals will allow you to set the objective of the vault to do so craft a seal and apply it in a Crystal Workbench.
Reach Vault Level 10

The Seal of the Sage when applied to a Crystal in the Crystal Workbench will set the Vault objective to Elixir.

Elixir Objective requires the player to find Elixir sources via looting, killing or mining. These actions will result in purple orbs filling the Objective bar at the top of the screen. When the bar is filled a player will have to find a Lodestone to exit. 

Players can set these orbs to show numbers in Vault Options - Accessibility - Vault - Elixir Orbs show numbers.
Acquire a Seal of the Sage

The Seal of the Scout when applied to a Crystal in the Crystal Workbench will set the Vault objective to Brazier.

Brazier Objective requires the player to find Braziers throughout vault rooms. These Braziers will have pros and cons, its up to the player to chose options that benefit their playstyle and vault.

Once the required amount of Braziers are collected a player can continue to pillage Braziers for additional loot. When finished a player must exit through the vault portal.
Acquire a Seal of the Scout

The Seal of the Scavenger when applied to a Crystal in the Crystal Workbench will set the Vault objective to Scavenger.

Scavenger Objective requires the player to find Scavenger Items from looting, killing and mining.

Once the required amount of Scavenger Items are collected a player can submit them to a Scavenger Altar to complete the vault.

We recommend setting up a Scavenger Pouch beforehand.
Acquire a Seal of the Scavenger

The Seal of the Prophet when applied to a Crystal in the Crystal Workbench will set the Vault objective to Bingo.

Bingo Objective requires the player to complete tasks on a bingo board. The more completed bingo lines the greater the reward. At Level 90 the bingo board will change to a 5x5 grid.

Some Bingo tasks may include:
Flawlessly: Take no damage.
Silently: Deal no damage.
Primitively: Use no mana.
Acquire a Seal of the Prophet

The Seal of the Executioner when applied to a Crystal in the Crystal Workbench will set the Vault objective to Hunt the Runes.

Hunt the Runes Objective requires the player to find runes while looting, killing and mining in the vault. Each rune can have a different modifier, and reward.
Submit the required number of runes to a Rune Pillar to summon the boss.
Acquire a Seal of the Executioner

The Black Market is where you can use soul shards to purchase items. There are a variety of rare items that you can roll in the Black Market.

A Black Market Token is used to reroll the items offered.
Interact with a Black Market

The Soul Diffuser breaks down vault items with a soul value into Soul Shards which can then be used at the Black Market.

Players that plan to break down lots of Soul Value items should upgrade to a Soul Harvester.
Acquire a Vault Soul Diffuser
The Identification Stand is a block that will instantly identify all gear when Right Clicked. This is extremely useful as you start to acquire large amounts of Vault Gear.
Acquire an Identification Stand

Knowledge is one of the key aspects to the Vault Hunters progression as it is the main component to unlocking new mods. 
Pressing the 'H' Key and selecting the Researches tab at the top will show you all the stuff you can unlock.

Note that purchasing some of these will increase the price of subsequent unlocks within that group of unlocks.

Mod Boxes hold a random item from your unlocked mods, use these to acquire unlocked modded items.
Craft a Knowledge Star

Level 20 marks the end of the tutorial stage of Vault Hunters!

You will no longer have Beginners Grace but dont worry, the next quest will explain the Spirit Extractor.
Vendoors and Dungeon doors will now start showing up. 

Keep up the Vaulting!
Reach Vault Level 20

The Spirit Extractor is used to recover loot lost within vaults. If you die, pick up your spirit by Sneak+Right-Clicking it and place it onto the Extractor by Right-Clicking it.
This will give you a price in Vault Gold that you will have to pay in order to retrieve your items.
Acquire a Spirit Extractor

Now that you have become level 20 you will be able to find Vendoors. Inside these special little rooms you will find an amount of Shop Pedestals with items atop them and a price listed.

The Bartering Expertise can help reduce the cost of these items.
Open a Vendoor inside a vault

Dungeons will now appear at level 20. A Dungeon entrance looks like a vault door themed after the mob type that will spawn inside. Right-clicking the door reveals the Dungeons difficulty in a pop-up and above the hotbar.
Dungeons have Barrels instead of Chest requiring a Breaking tool.

Players must explore through the dungeon encountering many spawners until the Dungeon Boss is found.
A Dungeon Boss will guard either an Imbuement Altar, Alchemy Archive, or Discovery Globe.
Open a Dungeon Door

The Crystal Workbench is used to apply various modifications to a Vault Crystal.
You can place a Crystal in the workbench, as well as a Seal, Augment, Capstone, Sigil, Inscriptions and Catalysts.

Seals determine the Vault Objective.
Augments change the Theme of the Vault. Once an Augment has been discovered you can craft them in the Augment Station.
Capstones apply additional modifiers.
Sigils increase the difficulty and have greater rewards.
Inscriptions add specific rooms.
Catalysts add Modifiers.

Crystals have a Capacity and every modification you do to a crystal can affect that Capacity.
Craft a Crystal Workbench

Catalyst can be applied in a Crystal Workbench to add modifiers to a Vault. Catalyst are a great way to target specific loot.

To craft Catalyst you need a Catalyst Infusion Table, along with Catalyst Fragments, Benitoite, and Dreamstone.
You can find Catalyst Fragments from unmodified vaults in Wooden Chests.
Craft a Catalyst Infusion Table

Inscriptions can be applied in a Crystal Workbench to add rooms to a Vault. 

To Craft Inscriptions you need an Inscription Table, and a variety of materials as each Inscription has its own recipe.
There are a variety of rooms ranging from Resource rooms, Challenge rooms, and Omega rooms.
You can find Inscription pieces from Wooden Chests.
Craft an Inscription Table

Pylons are rare player buffs found within the vault. These will offer the player temporary buffs to aid them during the vault or the player may break them to receive a Temporal Relic.

Temporal Relics are strong modifiers that can be added to the vault for 5 minutes when the player uses the item and will apply to the whole vault sharing the benefit with your party.
Break a Pylon to have a chance of getting a Temporal Relic

Artifacts are the key to obtaining a Herald Vault Rock.

To collect these 25 Artifacts, you will need to complete Vault Objectives and open the completion crates. 
Opening a crate has a small chance of rewarding an unidentified Artifact.
When opening unidentified Artifacts there will be a higher chance to get one that you have not gotten before.

The Prosperous modifier can guarantee an unidentified Artifact in the completion crate.

When all Artifacts are collected and displayed in the Artifact Tome, you can right click to retrieve a Herald Vault Rock. However this may take you some time and it is recommended for Lv100.
Acquire an Artifact Tome

Trinkets are powerful items that can be placed on the player to give the player either a stat boost or add a cool passive ability. To obtain a trinket, the player will need to loot Gilded Chests. They will drop at a low chance after level 20.

There are two types of trinkets, Red Trinkets and Blue Trinkets. You can only have one trinket of a each color on at a time.

The player can then craft discovered trinkets in the Trinket Forge.

Lastly Trinkets also have durability counted in uses. The trinket randomly rolls between 20 to 30 uses when identifying it. One usage goes down per vault the player enters.

The Trinket Forge is used to craft Trinkets. Once a player has identified a Trinket for the first time, that specific Trinket is permanently unlocked in the Forge and can be crafted repeatedly.

To craft a Trinket the player will need the following materials: Vault Diamonds, Vault Gold, Alexandrite, and Trinket Scrap.
Trinket Scrap is obtained by scrapping other trinkets in the Vault Recycler.
Acquire a Trinket Forge

Vault Hunters also offers a variety of different Vault Rocks.

Some of these include:

Plunders Rock: The player will have increased loot at the expense of experience.

Glazed Rock: This vault will have a new objective of finding cakes.
These rocks can be found in Vendoors and Black Markets.

Wardens Rock: Provides the player with the Afterlife Modifier, granting no item loss on death at the cost of half experience.

The Wardrobe is used to store Vault Gear, Vault Decks, God Charms, and Trinkets for quick switching between different builds.
It pairs perfectly with the Skill Altar for complete loadout management.
Interact with a Wardrobe

The Skill Altar is used to save Abilities and Talents in customizable tabs for easier skill swapping and build management.
Players can share builds as importable codes, allowing others to test configurations.

This system costs significantly less than manual reassignment and provides fully automatic saving, making it efficient for switching between different builds.

Players no longer need Regret Orbs to reset Skills, instead gold is used.
Interact with a Skill Altar
The Transmogrification Table allows you to transmog gear pieces to any unlocked transmog you have acquired. Place a gear piece to begin viewing transmogs!
Interact with a Transmogrification Table

Uniques are items that can be found within special rooms in the vault. These items cannot be rolled in the artisan station. Uniques can provide additional buffs to the player.

A Unique Codex can help you locate Uniques you may be searching for.

When you've collected a few Uniques you should craft a Unique Safe to store them.

Unique Gear can also be crafted using Unique Shards in the Vault Forge.
Craft the Unique Codex

Now that you have reached level 40, its time to introduce the Vault Gods.

God Altars will start spawning in rooms. Interacting with them will offer a task. Once the player finishes it, they will receive a reputation and a Favor based on the god they interacted with.

There are four Vault Gods. Each one of them blesses the player with different buffs upon completing their altar or wearing their Vault Charms.

Reputation is capped at 50.
Interact with a God Altar

Zealot Vaults are a way to increase God Reputation.
Craft a Zealot Vault by placing a God item on a Vault Altar instead of a Vault Rock. These god items include:
Velaran Emerald Apple, Idonian Sacrificial Dagger, Tome of Tenos, Wendarrian Focus Gem.

Reaching Vault Level 50 marks the halfway point in terms of levels, this means that you currently have half of your total expertise points already. The Neuralizer allows you to completely reset your currently learned expertise points in case you change your mind and decide that another expertise may suit your needs better!
Reach Vault Level 50

Vault Cards start appearing once you reach Level 50.
Cards can be placed into a Vault Deck, which is then equipped in a curio slot to activate the bonuses.

Cards have a type, one or more groups, a color, and can also roll as a foil variant. Some card types use conditions or scaling rules that depend on nearby cards in the deck.

The Card Binder is a workstation that provides infinite storage for cards and is primarily used for card management and deck building.

The Unboxing Station is a workstation used to open Card Booster Packs and Jewel Pouches, allowing players to either select rewards manually or automatically scrap their contents.

The Card Upgrade Station is a workstation that allows players to upgrade cards using Card Juice, increasing their effectiveness.

If you have unwanted cards you can recycle them in the Vault Recycler.

The Deck Station is a workstation used to craft Card Decks and Lesser Cores.
Each deck has a unique layout and number of sockets.
The Advanced Decks tab requires the Vault Decks research to access.

Cores are augments that can be applied to decks in an anvil. More powerful cores can be found throughout your adventures in the vaults.

Its worth mentioning once a core is applied to a deck it cannot be removed. You can use a more powerful core of similar type to upgrade the deck, but you cannot swap cores.

Cores and their Greater version can be recycled in the Vault Recycler.
Interact with a Deck Station

Reaching Level 50 will start spawning Treasure Doors in vaults. These doors can be opened using a matching Treasure Key corresponding to the color and gem type of the door.

Treasure Keys are used to open matching Treasure Doors. A key is consumed when the door is opened. Keys can also be used from a Treasure Keyring.

Key pieces can be found in Gilded Chests. These can be used to craft a Blank Key. A Blank Key can then be combined with a matching legendary gem cluster in an anvil to create a Treasure Key.
Interact with a Treasure Pedestal

The Gear Sealer is a Workstation used to apply Ascendant Marks to gear pieces. Using the Gear Sealer consumes Gold, Painite, and an Ascendant Mark to replace one existing affix on an item with a Sealed Modifier.

Once a gear piece is sealed you can not modify it further.
Craft a Gear Sealer

Antiques are rare collectibles that look like stamps. They can be collected inside the vault doing various tasks.
To get these items to spawn, you will need an Antique Stamp Collector Book. This book is available after level 50.

When a set is collected, it can be taken out and right clicked in a hand to give you the reward.
Craft an Antique Stamp Collector book

Once you reach level 50 or higher, the Egg Hunt event can occur once per vault.
To hatch a Companion Egg craft a Companion Incubator, insert the egg and wait for it to hatch.

Once your Companion Hatches you can place the Companion in a Companion Home. 
A Companion Home is where you can equip Relics and Particles.

You can make a Companion Relic Table to craft more Relics and Trails for your Companion.

If your Companion loses a heart you can feed them a Companion Snack. Companions will gain extra lives on Lv4, Lv7, Lv9, Lv10.

The Companion Locker can store an infinite number of companions and automatically keeps them on break while stored. This makes it ideal for base organization, long-term storage, and reducing entity clutter.
Craft a Companion Incubator

Upon reaching level 65 you unlock the possibility to craft a Challengers Vault Rock.
This crystal can not be modified, and keeps track of your win streak (ascension). Every time you successfully complete an Ascension Vault the difficulty will increase.

Embers are the currency award for completing the Ascension Vault and can be used at the Ascension Forge.

The Ascension Forge contains special Transmogs.
Craft an Ascension Forge

Wolds Vaults offers some Enhanced seals. All of these Seals increase the difficulty of the Vault and offer a unique twist, complete them and be greatly rewarded.

Seal of the Enchanter: Enhanced version of Elixir Rush. As you fill your elixir bar random events will trigger.

Seal of the Exorcist: Enhanced version of Light the Braziers, offers more modifiers on Braziers with more effects.

Seal of the Psychopath: Enhanced Scavenger, requiring more Scavenger items and changing where items come from.

Seal of the Doomslayer: The bigger and better Bingo board, with random events.

Seal of the Alchemist: Is a unique objective, requiring you to bring brewing ingredients to a Brewing Altar.
The Customization Station lets you personalise your appearance. Use it to tweak cosmetic settings without affecting any gameplay stats.
Acquire a Customization Station

After level 60 you have a rare chance of finding an Imbuement Altar, the larger the dungeon the higher the chance to find one.

Place an item in the Imbuement Altar and you will be shown three options to choose from.

If the Imbuement fails the gear becomes corrupted and the modifier will be downgraded.
Interact with an Imbuement Altar

Congratulations on reaching max level. Now the real fun begins.

At this point you should be ready to face the Herald. Gather the last Artifacts, and craft your Herald Rock.

Once the Herald is defeated you can start Greeding.
Reach Vault Level 100 & Defeat the Herald
